question.text: What do you do at a flooded road?

answer.text: Vehicles account for nearly half of flash-flood deaths. As little as six inches of moving water may carry a vehicle away, including a sport utility vehicle or pickup. Do not cross a flooded roadway or bridge; turn back and choose another route. Leave a vehicle that stalls in floodwater and head to higher ground.
